newsitem.title: CHILE: Banco Santiago stock issue approved.
newsitem.headline: Banco Santiago stock issue approved.

text.p: Chile's main banking regulatory authority gave its final approval to a $150 million capital increase by Banco Santiago through placement of new stock approved at a shareholders' meeting on May 23.
The Superintendency of Banks and Financial Institutions published its approval of the capital increase in a resolution in the weekend edition of the official gazette.

The resolution grants regulatory approval to Banco Santiago's plans for a capital increase of 63 billion pesos through placement of 7.8 billion shares. The bank will have one year from June 11 to place the shares, according to the resolution.
The new stock will raise the bank's capital to 329.8 billion pesos, represented by 98.9 billion ordinary shares, it said.
Banco Santiago was created last year in the merger of Banco de Santiago and Banco O'Higgins, and is Chile's largest private bank.

The capital increase was approved at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting last month at which it also approved a $200 million international bond issue. The bank expects to place the bonds by October at the latest, officials have said.
